_meta.purpose: Golden fixture for the detector-portability proof (AC2). The RAW Service Cloud approval-process block below is fed to the ORIGINAL APPROVAL_BOTTLENECK (approval_delay.py) and PERMISSION_BOTTLENECK (permission_bottleneck.py) detectors; the SAME block is mapped to normalised concepts (mappers.map_service_cloud_approvals) and fed to the concept-native ports (portable_detectors). The test asserts the two produce identical DetectorResults.
_meta.shape: The exact keys discovery.detectors.approval_delay / permission_bottleneck read on sf_data: approval_processes[].{process_name, pending_count, avg_delay_days, approver_count, bottleneck_score}. approver_ids is present to prove the mapper normalises the approver COUNT (ActorGroup.member_count) and drops the individual roster — groups, never individuals.

branch_coverage.Underwriting Referral Review: APPROVAL_BOTTLENECK combined-fire (delay>3 AND bottleneck>10); PERMISSION_BOTTLENECK fires (bottleneck>10, approvers>0)
branch_coverage.Change Freeze Sign-off: APPROVAL_BOTTLENECK severe-delay-fire only (delay>7); PERMISSION does NOT (bottleneck<=10)
branch_coverage.Access Request Review: PERMISSION_BOTTLENECK only (bottleneck>10, approvers>0); APPROVAL does NOT (delay not >3 and not >7)
branch_coverage.Automated Risk Gate: APPROVAL_BOTTLENECK fires (combined) but PERMISSION does NOT (approver_count==0 guard)
branch_coverage.Policy Endorsement Approval: negative control — neither fires; pending_count 0 exercises the mapper's decision='approved' path
